parameters.content:
## Amazon Review Aggregates & Extended History Scraper

**Actor:** [Amazon Review Aggregates & Extended History Scraper](https://apify.com/dataspryva/amazon-review-aggregates-and-extended-history)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/amazon-review-aggregates-and-extended-history-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `productUrls` (array)
- `keywords` (array)
- `categoryUrls` (array)
- `maxProductsToDiscover` (integer)
- `extendedHistory` (boolean)
- `mergeMarketplaces` (array)
- `includeAggregates` (boolean)
- `country` (string)
- `maxReviews` (integer)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `filterByStar` (string)
- `verifiedPurchasesOnly` (boolean)

### Output fields
- `productAsin` (ASIN)
- `reviewedProductAsin` (Reviewed Product Asin)
- `ratingScore` (Rating)
- `reviewTitle` (Title)
- `reviewDescription` (Review Description)
- `isVerified` (Verified)
- `isVineVoice` (Is Vine Voice)
- `reviewedIn` (Reviewed In)
- `reviewReaction` (Review Reaction)
- `variant` (Variant)
- `reviewImages` (Review Images)
- `reviewId` (Review ID)

description: Amazon reviews across marketplaces: runs the Amazon Review Aggregates & Extended History Scraper Apify Actor, returns productAsin, ratingScore, reviewTitle, reviewDescription, isVerified and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
